reddit_quotes: I've used TWSBI Eco for 36 months. I bought three of these and kept two.
TWSBI Eco is the kind of thing you don't appreciate until you've used the cheap alternative and regretted it.
The TWSBI Eco community is split, but the people who actually own them tend to keep them.
detractor_quote: I returned my TWSBI Eco after two weeks. The QC was terrible.
